name: food-product-data-scraper
title: Food Product Data Scraper: Barcode & Name Lookup
description: Look up food products in bulk by barcode (EAN/UPC) or by name. For each product: name, brand, quantity, ingredients, allergens, Nutri-Score, NOVA group, nutrition per 100g and a photo URL. For grocery apps, e-commerce listings and nutrition tools. No API key needed.
